dishes.name: Baked Cinnamon Apples
dishes.description: The perfect variety for baking, Granny Smith apples are the secret to this down-home dish. With a dusting of cinnamon and sugar, it's just mellow enough to serve as a complementary side and just sweet enough to save for dessert. Side arrives frozen. Just Heat and Serve.

dishes.name: Cheesy Potatoes Au Gratin
dishes.description: Yum - a big family favorite that takes no time at all! Our special recipe takes generous slices of select gold potatoes, then smothers them in a rich, creamy blend of cheddar cheeses. All you do is bake to perfection. Side arrives frozen. Just Heat and Serve.

dishes.name: Green Bean Casserole
dishes.description: Farm-fresh green beans with a healthy dose of out-of-this-world flavor makes this dish welcome at any table. It all starts with fine green beans - young, tender and at the peak of flavor. These morsels are mixed with mushrooms and red peppers, tossed in a cream sauce, topped with crispy fried onions. Side arrives frozen. Just Heat and Serve.

dishes.name: Loaded Smashed Potatoes
dishes.description: This will be your next family favorite! The loaded smashed potatoes features smashed russet potatoes smothered with butter, cheddar cheese, crispy bacon and chives. Serves 2-4. Sides arrive frozen, Just Heat and Serve

dishes.name: Double Cheddar Macaroni and Cheese
dishes.description: This sensational side combines tender corkscrew pasta tossed in creamy white cheddar cheese sauce, topped with cheddar cheese. Kids love it as well as adults. It makes a delicious accompaniment to the Honey Baked Ham as well as our many other specialty meats. It's as good as homemade and a lot less work. Side arrives frozen. Just Heat and Serve.

dishes.name: Maple Sweet Potato Souffle
dishes.description: Our special recipe takes generous slices of select sweet potatoes and whips them into a creamy, smooth soufflé with brown sugar and spices, topped with crunchy pecans. All you do is bake to perfection. Side arrives frozen. Just Heat and Serve.

dishes.name: Tuscan-Style Broccoli
dishes.description: Farm-fresh broccoli with a healthy dose of out-of-this-world flavor makes this dish welcome at any table. Ready to roast tuscan-style broccoli tossed with lemon, garlic, olive oil and parmesan cheese. A delicious new take on a family favorite! Side arrives frozen. Just Heat and Serve.

dishes.name: Savory Gravy
dishes.description: Whether you are celebrating a romantic evening, a holiday or some other type of festive occasion, the one thing that your meal should not be without is our HoneyBaked Gravy. With a rich oven-roasted taste it pairs well with everything!

dishes.name: HoneyBaked Beans
dishes.description: A blend of Great Northern Beans and Black-Eyed Peas with Honey Baked Ham in a Zesty Sauce. Serves 4-6. Side arrives frozen. Just heat and serve.

dishes.name: Red Velvet Cake
dishes.description: Our HoneyBaked Red Velvet Cake is topped with rich shavings of white chocolate for a touch of elegance and sophistication. Each slice features three layers of cake gently separated by two layers of decadent cream cheese icing. Few dessert offerings are as classically delicious as Red Velvet Cake. Whether you are making plans to entertain a large group of people at a formal event or host an intimate holiday dinner, our limited time only Red Velvet dessert will make the occasion unforgettable. Made with alternating layers of moist cake and velvety cream cheese icing, each bite is absolutely heavenly.

dishes.name: Southern Pecan Pie
dishes.description: Serve your guests a slice of down-home comfort to top off the perfect meal. Like all of our products, our Southern Pecan Pie is made from the finest ingredients for flavor beyond compare. The crisp, flaky crust is filled with brown sugar, warm spices and syrup, whole eggs and chopped pecans. The pie is hand-topped with roasted pecan halves for a deep, buttery flavor certain to satisfy your sweet tooth. Serves 8

dishes.name: Cinnamon Walnut Coffee Cake
dishes.description: Our HoneyBaked Cinnamon Walnut Coffee Cake takes all the work out of dessert. Packed with mouth-watering flavor, each cake provides the perfect fuss-free solution to any event requiring a sweet finale. Whether you are planning a small tea party or a large formal gathering, our moist Coffee Cake is a perfect crowd-pleaser. Each fluffy cake layer is made with sour cream for ultimate moisture and texture. A soft layer of sweet cinnamon streusel and crunchy Mariani walnuts provides textural interest and mouth-watering flavor in each bite. Serves 10

dishes.name: Blueberry Coffee Cake
dishes.description: Light up your next get together with a delicious 9-inch blueberry coffee cake from HoneyBaked Ham. This tempting treat is made with natural ingredients like real sour cream and sugar for the rich, pure flavors you remember. Serve this moist, dense traditional blueberry cake to guests enjoying tea or coffee, add a platter of slices to a breakfast or brunch spread, or simply enjoy sharing this cake after dinner. Each slice is full of plump blueberries, so you can enjoy the flavors of summer all year long. Like other HoneyBaked Ham cakes, this one has been made in small batches for the best quality and then baked to a golden brown; it arrives ready to slice and serve.

dishes.name: Pumpkin Pie
dishes.description: Fully baked and seasoned with All-Spice, Cinnamon, Cloves, Ginger & Nutmeg.

dishes.name: Split Pea Soup Mix
dishes.description: Delicious tasting homemade soup mixes. Enjoy your Honey Baked Ham down to the bone! Create another memorable meal using our delicious, nutritious soup mix. Spices are included, simply add water and ham bone. Ham or ham bone is sold separately. Approximately 3 hours cooking time.
